arguments.description: One isolated narrow suspended timber footbridge for a sacred mountain monastery, shown across a transparent gap with clearly open left and right connection ends. Slight natural sag, dozens of individually readable weathered wooden planks, paired supporting ropes and a few small hanging bells, dark timber with pale-stone end brackets and restrained turquoise ties. Practical bridge silhouette, no cliff, temple, background, text or cast shadow. Shallow three-quarter view consistent with roofs and front faces, upper-left light, crisp selective outline, deliberate refined pixel clusters. Transparent background and generous margin.
